source.document: THALOMID (thalidomide) capsules, for oral use. Full prescribing information. Celgene Corporation; marketed by Bristol-Myers Squibb Company.

mm_200_mg_daily.quote: The recommended dose of THALOMID in combination with dexamethasone is 200 mg once daily (in 28-day treatment cycles) orally with water, preferably at bedtime and at least 1 hour after the evening meal.

single_dose_table_healthy.quote: Table 5: Pharmacokinetic Parameter Values for THALOMID Mean (%CV)

single_dose_table_hansen.population: patients with Hansen's disease, n=6; recorded, not for myeloma use
single_dose_table_hansen.quote: Table 5: Pharmacokinetic Parameter Values for THALOMID Mean (%CV)

linearity.quote: While the extent of absorption (as measured by area under the curve [AUC]) is proportional to dose in healthy subjects, the observed peak concentration (Cmax) increased in a less than proportional manner (see Table 5 below).

tmax_h.quote: The maximum plasma concentrations are reached approximately 2-5 hours after administration.

bioavailability.quote: The absolute bioavailability of thalidomide from thalidomide capsules has not yet been characterized in human subjects due to its poor aqueous solubility.

food.quote: Coadministration of THALOMID (thalidomide) with a high-fat meal causes minor (<10%) changes in the observed AUC and Cmax values; however, it causes an increase in Tmax to approximately 6 hours.

protein_binding_percent.quote: In human plasma, the geometric mean plasma protein binding was 55% and 66%, respectively, for (+)-(R)- and (-)-(S)-thalidomide.

half_life_h.quote: The mean elimination half-life of thalidomide in plasma following single oral doses between 50 mg and 400 mg was 5.5 to 7.3 hours.

fraction_excreted_unchanged_urine.quote: Unchanged thalidomide is not eliminated by the kidney to a notable degree (<3.5% of the dose).

cl_l_h_mm_by_weight.quote: In MM patients with body weight from 47-133 kg, thalidomide clearance ranged from approximately 6-12 L/h, representing an increase in thalidomide clearance of 0.605 L/h per 10 kg body weight increase.

renal.stated_as: not expected to influence exposure (not studied)
renal.quote: Patients with Renal Impairment: Renal impairment is not expected to influence drug exposure since <3.5% of the dose is excreted in the urine as unchanged drug.

hepatic.quote: Patients with Hepatic Impairment: No clinical studies have been conducted in patients with hepatic impairment.

age_sex.stated_as: no age-related changes (20-69 years); no significant sex differences
age_sex.quote: Analysis of the data from pharmacokinetic studies in healthy volunteers and patients with Hansen's disease ranging in age from 20 to 69 years does not reveal any age-related changes.

cyp450.result: not a CYP450 substrate, inhibitor or inducer; interactions not anticipated
cyp450.quote: Pharmacokinetic drug-drug interactions with substrates, inhibitors or inducers of CYP450 are not anticipated.

not_stated: Exposure in multiple myeloma patients at the 200 mg dose (Table 5 is healthy subjects and Hansen's disease).
Clearance in healthy subjects as a number.
